title: Banana Granola with Tropical Dried Fruit and Nuts
changes_from_base: Oats, wheat germ, flaxseed and chia soak up a spiced banana purée and sugar before a long, slow bake, then are tossed with toasted mixed nuts and dried mango, cherries and blueberries; no honey syrup.
summary: This fruit-and-nut granola is built on a foundation of banana purée, creating naturally sweet clusters loaded with dried mango, cherries and blueberries alongside toasted nuts.
equipment: large rimmed baking tray (about 33 x 46 cm)

ingredients.item: very ripe banana purée (about 4 black-skinned bananas)
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
dried mango, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Mash 400 g very ripe banana to a smooth paste with a fork, then stir through 3 tsp vanilla, ½ tsp fine salt, ½ tsp ground cinnamon, ½ tsp ground cloves and ¼ tsp grated nutmeg.

steps.title: Assembly
steps.text: In a large bowl, combine 340 g rolled oats, 40 g toasted wheat germ, 30 g ground flaxseed, 15 g chia seeds and 200 g caster sugar; add the banana mixture and 85 g melted coconut oil, stirring well until it resembles wet sand.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cover the bowl and leave for 30 min so the oats can absorb the liquid.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Meanwhile, toss 60 g pumpkin seeds, 60 g walnuts, 70 g roughly chopped macadamia nuts and 65 g pecan pieces with 1 tsp neutral oil and a pinch of fine salt on a tray, then toast for about 15 min, stirring once, until golden; set aside to cool.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread the oat mixture evenly on a lined large tray and bake at 150 °C (130 °C fan) for about 1 h 50 min, using two forks to stir and break up the mixture every 20-30 min, until deep brown and dry to the touch.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Let cool fully on the tray as it will crisp further.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Mix in the cooled toasted nuts, 115 g dried mango cut into bite-size pieces, 85 g dried sour cherries and 55 g dried blueberries.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: Keep in an airtight container in a cool place.

tips: Toast the nuts separately before adding for maximum crunch and flavour
Stir the granola frequently during baking to guarantee even browning and drying
Let the banana mixture sit in the oats before baking so they absorb all the moisture
storage: Store in an airtight container in a cool place for up to 6 weeks, or freeze for up to 3 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
